notes:
Company snapshot: Pyxis builds a multi-tenant cloud contact center used by mid-size telco and retail clients. They want to add live agent-assist, automated ticket summarization, and outbound personalization with locale-aware tone. Key ask: consistent semantics across translations and deterministic behavior during traffic spikes.

Quotes/clips: 'If we lose 2-3% accuracy in translation for legal content we could be in trouble' (Localization Lead). 'Cost per ticket needs to stay < $0.40 in peak hours' (Head of Ops).

Procurement profile: procurement + legal involved early. Preference for VPC/private for production, but ok with hosted for POC. Want optional on-prem connector for one regulated client.

Operational concerns: spikes during billing cycles and product launches — must gracefully fallback to smaller model variant or cached responses. Interested in per-route SLOs and token-level cost dashboards.

References: security deck link + pricing deck shared in Drive. Jira SUP-1429 opened for regional routing questions.
technical_requirements: SLOs: 95th pct latency < 350ms for agent-assist (token streaming allowed). Throughput: 2,500 concurrent active agents across NA + EU with burst to 6k for product launches. Fallbacks required: primary model -> low-cost quantized variant -> cached template responses. Must support prefix/KV caching, deterministic reranking for ticket summarization, and tool-calling to CRM with idempotency. Translation: support locale-sensitive tone profiles per region (es-MX vs es-ES). Token encryption at rest via customer-managed KMS. Audit logs retained 13 months.
poc_success_metrics: POC criteria: 1) translation fidelity >= 92% (BLEU+human spot-check) across target languages; 2) agent-assist 95th pct latency < 350ms under 48h spike test; 3) cost per ticket within 15% of projected model; 4) security review signoff (SOC2 + KMS integration confirmed).
